description: This Java source file defines the AbstractApplication class, a base class for Spring Boot applications within the Eclipse Hono project. It manages service factories, deployment of verticles, and lifecycle hooks for deploying services in a Vert.x environment.

classes.name: AbstractApplication
classes.description: A base class for implementing Spring Boot applications that deploy Vert.x service verticles, managing service factories and deployment lifecycle.

methods.name: preFlightCheck
methods.description: Checks if service factories are configured before startup.

methods.name: addServiceFactories
methods.description: Adds service factory instances to the application.

methods.name: deployRequiredVerticles
methods.description: Pre-deployment hook for additional verticles, default returns succeeded future.

methods.name: deployServiceVerticles
methods.description: Deploys service verticles based on configured factories and max instances.

methods.name: preDeploy
methods.description: Hook invoked before deploying each service instance; default does nothing.

methods.name: postDeploy
methods.description: Hook invoked after deploying each service instance; default does nothing.

methods.name: deployVerticles
methods.description: Coordinates deployment of base and service verticles.
